evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring cadence (conservation: stability, keeping what works) and frames rehearsal as a standing operational capability (competence: maintaining mastery of rollback procedures).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic framing equates unrehearsed with nonexistent — capability only counts if proven through practice, appealing to competence as the good and conservation (security of actually having the rollback) as its precondition.
Records a fixed recurring schedule as an organizational good — stability and security through regular practice.
Assigning ownership names a single accountable party for the rehearsal capability — competence as distributed mastery with a named owner.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the expression equating unpracticed capability with absence of that capability — making rehearsal the proof of possession?
